info.prompt: Close-up of a die mid-roll on a bio-mechanical altar: skeletal gold filigree veins glow amber under pressure, the die's translucent "specimen" core flashing neon cyan/magenta with each heartbeat pulse (40Hz sub-bass visible as distortion waves), while hacker-terminal overlays scroll corrupted Latin incantations across the void-black background crisscrossed by synaptic lightning.
